metadata.title: Determination of all diffeomorphism invariant tensor fields on the space of smooth positive densities on a compact manifold with corners
metadata.abstract: It was proved in [3] that on a closed manifold of dimension greater than one, every smooth weak Riemannian metric on the space of smooth positive probability densities, that is invariant under the action of the diffeomorphism group, is a multiple of the Fisher-Rao metric. Here we extend this result to compact manifolds with corners, and we determine all diffeomorphism invariant tensor fields on the space of smooth positive probability densities.

analysis.progressType: 密度空间的不变张量分类
analysis.workSummary: 把闭流形上微分同胚不变弱黎曼度量的 Fisher–Rao 唯一性推广到带角紧流形，并确定正概率密度空间的所有微分同胚不变张量。
analysis.breakthrough: 从二阶度量扩展为一般张量分类。
analysis.limitations: 对象为光滑正概率密度，边界角与低维例外需看完整条件。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 信息几何与无限维几何的工具型结果。
